about: Topic dividers and pause cards for the Week 6 video (Britt, 2026-10-08). A divider plays silently before its chapter's narration; a pause card holds 10 seconds of silence after it. Read by normalize-pace.py and build-media.py; tests/content/dl2-video-cards.spec.js checks every worksheet reference.
